decision.title: Should release CI adopt a shared build cache now?
decision.summary: Adopt only an architecture-scoped cache and keep the speed claim insufficient until measured.

claims.text: The documented key can scope cache restoration by lockfile and runner architecture.

evidence.excerpt: Cache keys include the dependency lockfile and runner architecture before a release artifact can be restored.

claims.text: Cached native binaries are safe to restore across runner architectures.

evidence.excerpt: A stale cache restored incompatible native binaries after the runner architecture changed.

claims.text: The cache will reduce median release duration by at least 30 percent.

evidence.excerpt: Cache keys include the dependency lockfile and runner architecture before a release artifact can be restored.

claims.limitation: Neither synthetic source contains measured release-duration data.
